question: Which subsidiary body of the United Nations Security Council was established by Resolution 1373 to monitor the implementation of counter-terrorism measures by member states?
options: The ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions Committee
explanation: UN Security Council Resolution 1373, adopted unanimously in the wake of the September 11 attacks, established the Counter-Terrorism Committee (CTC) as a special body of the Council to monitor implementation of the resolution's sweeping counter-terrorism obligations.
